verdict.rationale: Cake Equity is a SaaS cap table platform, so outbound webhooks are a fair question to ask of it. However, the evidence pack contains no documented, registrable HTTP callbacks. The closest items do not qualify: a read-only MCP server is an adjacent integration, and automatic notifications to a registered agent are communications to a corporate service provider, not programmatic event callbacks. The OpenAPI probe also returned 404 at all candidate paths.
